outline.label: Read the worldview, then inspect its warrant
outline.proposal: Keep adoption distinct from evidence in the source drawer, rather than implying that publication proved the worldview.

outline.label: Use the model with its conditions
outline.proposal: Place the comparability assumptions beside any comparison widget; preserve a Pareto reading when the axes are only independently ordinal.

outline.label: Cooperate without erasing the counterexample
outline.proposal: Link the cooperation story to its explicit one-shot counterexample and distinguish model interdependence from chosen admissibility.

outline.label: Practice provisional public wisdom
outline.proposal: Show the Compact's provisional warrant and kill criteria together; invite evidence and correction without promoting the policy to a proven result.
